meta.name: alterlab-cobrapy
meta.description: Build and analyze genome-scale constraint-based metabolic models with COBRApy — flux balance analysis (FBA), flux variability analysis (FVA), gene and reaction knockouts, flux sampling, and SBML model I/O. Use when simulating metabolic networks, predicting growth or knockout phenotypes, or running systems-biology and metabolic-engineering analyses on SBML genome-scale models. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 模拟代谢网络并预测基因敲除表型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用COBRApy做代谢网络模拟或代谢工程分析
copy.tagline_en: Simulate metabolic networks and predict knockout phenotypes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are simulating metabolic networks or analyzing metabolic engineering with COBRApy

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 COBRApy 分析代谢模型，进行通量平衡分析、基因敲除模拟、通量采样等，并读写 SBML 模型文件。
howto.when: 当你要求模拟代谢网络、预测生长或敲除表型，或进行系统生物学与代谢工程分析时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型，运行通量平衡分析。
say.note: Claude 会加载模型并输出生长速率。

say.text: 对 iJO1366 模型做单基因敲除筛选。
say.note: Claude 会执行单基因敲除并返回必需基因列表。

say.text: 计算最小培养基，使生长达到最大值的50%。
say.note: Claude 会计算并列出最小培养基成分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use COBRApy to analyze metabolic models, perform flux balance analysis, gene knockout simulations, flux sampling, and read/write SBML model files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to simulate metabolic networks, predict growth or knockout phenotypes, or run systems-biology and metabolic-engineering analyses.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and run flux balance analysis.
say_en.note: Claude will load the model and output the growth rate.

say_en.text: Perform single gene deletion screening on the iJO1366 model.
say_en.note: Claude will execute single gene deletions and return essential genes.

say_en.text: Compute minimal medium for 50% of maximum growth.
say_en.note: Claude will compute and list minimal medium components.
